headline: Florida Tech overtake Florida Southern at the top
dek: Florida Tech's win over Palm Beach Atlantic lifted them above Florida Southern, who hold a match in hand and have lost once all season against ten wins. The two meet at Florida Tech in the last match either side has scheduled.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are pooled at one end of the chart: Florida Southern alone have outscored Barry and Nova Southeastern put together, and the side now above them in the table has scored well short of their total.

wire.line: Florida Southern are the only side in the conference yet to lose a conference match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches have passed their date with no result; Palm Beach Atlantic are party to all of them but Eckerd's home match against Trinity.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Kobi Thomas has scored fifteen of Palm Beach Atlantic's 24 goals this season, from 51 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finlay Prain has scored twelve of Rollins' 22 goals this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Marcos da Silva has kept five clean sheets for Embry-Riddle.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Nova Southeastern have conceded 30 goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

last_match.line: Palm Beach Atlantic have now lost to both of the sides at the top of the table.

next_match.line: Florida Southern are yet to lose a conference match; Tampa have not won since beating Barry in September.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
